git_sha: to be stamped by training/kaggle/push.sh at launch

dataset.note: metadata.csv = 4013 train rows; n_wavs also counts the 212 held-out test clips (test.csv) that training never reads. base_checkpoint.current_best_known_final: runs/hi_f/v4_final_step357212.ckpt (verified step 357212) unless v5's final (runs/hi_f/last.ckpt after ~07:25 UTC) verifies higher

lr.note: exponential 1e-4 -> 5e-6 over 150 epochs (about one 11 h session), then held; the previous plan of 160 epochs assumed 336 steps/epoch, measured 302

evaluation: bench.compare_checkpoints on milestones, repeats>=3, same 50-sentence set, bootstrap CIs; decision rule in docs/training.md
